entries.description: Changed recommended models to GPT 6 Luna, GPT 6 Sol, GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Ada 002, added a capability level column, and updated deployment-name setup steps.
Added the 7.11.32 release notes, covering fixes for Teamwork and People Rollup, Page Bulk Update, Media Picker, identity sync, and Bing image search.
Added release notes for version 7.11.31, covering bidirectional People Rollup, Burmese language support, search improvements, and a Business Profile onboarding redirect fix.
Added release notes for version 7.11.28, listing fixes and improvements to Rich Text Editor, rollups, Properties block, Digital Signage and approval workflow emails.
Added a pointer to the Microsoft Search connectors page for the search paths and template mappings needed for external items.
Added a pointer in the Integration section to the Microsoft Search connectors page for setup instructions for that feature.
Added a cross-reference to the Microsoft Search connectors page for Microsoft 365 Copilot connector external items in the search categories section.
Added a guide for showing Microsoft 365 Copilot connector items in Omnia Search, covering Graph checks, setup, a template limitation and troubleshooting.
Added a Microsoft Search connectors section to the Search page's list of linked sections, placed after Search configuration.
Added a step-by-step Microsoft Copilot Studio MCP setup guide with troubleshooting, plus notes on one-time client secret display and the optional Redirect URI.
New page documenting how to read and manage primary and secondary theme colours for business profiles using the connector.
Added documentation for Shared Links covering how editors can publish links for intranet users, including usage examples and available API actions.
Added documentation for the Search feature, which lets users search the intranet from conversation and use results for summarizing, comparing, or creating new content.
Added MCP documentation for Publishing Apps, explaining how to create, list, and manage apps through the connector.
Added documentation page for Publishing App templates in the MCP connector, covering template creation, configuration options, and usage examples.
Added new page documenting enterprise properties as tenant-wide metadata fields and connector operations for managing them.
Adds documentation for Enterprise property MCP functionality, explaining how to list, create, and manage tenant-wide metadata fields.
Added documentation page explaining enterprise property sets, their usage in Publishing App templates, and the EnterprisePropertySet.List action.
Added documentation for the Pages MCP connector, covering page creation, property management, image handling, publishing, and archiving operations.
Added documentation for tenant page types, covering creation, modification, and configuration options.
Added documentation for page collection creation and settings management, including guidance on structure, layout, collaboration, scheduling, and AI configuration.
Added documentation for My Links feature covering personal link shortcuts, management operations, and connector actions.
Added documentation for MCP context feature, explaining how tenant administrators can configure and read tenant-wide guidance that shapes chat sessions.
Added documentation for tenant languages management, covering how to read, add, remove, and modify tenant languages and default language settings.
Added Languages page documenting how tenant and business profile language settings enable multilingual content in Omnia.
Added documentation for business profile languages, covering language configuration, inheritance settings, and available API actions.
Expanded introduction with detailed explanations of how the Omnia connector works, including conversation flow, tool usage, and permission model.
Added documentation page explaining how to use the Features connector to list, activate, and deactivate features at tenant, business profile, and app instance levels.
New documentation page for configuring Omnia's date and time format, including date format, time format, and first day of week settings.
Added documentation for creating business profiles through the MCP connector, including prerequisites, examples, and key considerations for profile management.
New page documenting Azure AD permissions connector for checking tenant consent status and which Omnia features require specific permissions.
Added documentation page explaining announcement types, their management per business profile, and the available actions for listing, adding, renaming, and removing them.
New page documenting how to manage announcement statuses for tracking message states like Active, Resolved, and Postponed.
Added documentation for using the Announcements feature, including how to list, read, publish, update and remove announcements through the connector.
